defaults_provenance: entering-model capture; hypothetical package specification, not vendor capacity

public_inputs.capture_source: p_cryo direct input; unspecified cold stage
public_inputs.name: rated_direct_electric_MW

screen_guards: Boolean flags; finite nonnegative rating; finite nonnegative active demand; finite resulting margin
point_state_guards: Boolean enabled; helium/salt actual mode must be numeric0/1; disabled or mode0 short circuits; active actual and supplied state values finite; fixed eight-ULP numerical identity only
state_identity: finite a,b and (a == b or abs(a-b) <= 8 * max(math.ulp(a), math.ulp(b))); fixed numerical identity only, no public tolerance
output_path_note: Screen margin_output and defined_output are actual native producer keys. Source EXPOSE aliases remain the formal bindings and are separately named source_margin_alias/source_defined_alias; this route does not emit those aliases as numeric channel keys.
